disease_family: Adult diffuse glioma (LGG and GBM, IDH-mutant and IDH-wildtype)
out_of_scope_v0_1: Pediatric brain tumors, primary CNS lymphoma, brain metastases (separate card if commercially relevant)
rationale_class_choice: Whole blood is the dominant v1 specimen pathway. Whole blood is dominated by immune cells, so Stage 1 scores immune class. Terminal class becomes the relevant scoring class only on CSF, tumor tissue, or cfMeDIP-seq-enriched plasma — see Pathway 3 multi-specimen tier table.
validation_tier_overall: v0.1 has two specimen pathways tested. Blood arm exploratory (no internal controls, cross-platform reference). Tissue arm single-cohort-validated with on-study controls and substrate-scope caveat. Other pathways (CSF / cfMeDIP-seq plasma / lymphatic) remain pre-validation_skeleton or external_classifier_validated.
validation_floor_explanation: Blood arm: VAL-088 cohort (GSE180683 n=76 EPIC). External cross-platform reference (GSE51057 HM450). Direction-of-effect d ≈ 0.9 [95% CI 0.6, 1.2]. Replication on UCSF AGS phs001497 required for upgrade. Tissue arm: VAL-089 cohort (GSE60274 n=72 GBM + 5 NTB on 450K). On-study controls eliminate cross-platform confound. GBM primary d=+0.24 wide CI; recurrent d=+1.17; spheres d=-1.81 inversion validates Shannon-entropy=cell-mixture-diversity interpretation. Replication on GSE90496/GSE143843/TCGA required for tighter CI.
issue_002_prediction_substrate_scope: Issue 002 figures (LGG ΔA = +0.239, GBM ΔA = +0.217, terminal class A_combined ≈ 1.10 FLOOR BREACH) refer to TUMOR TISSUE 5-substrate cfDNA combined target (L2/L3 platform). v1 single-substrate methyl-only readings are different scope and not directly comparable. CHK-1.5 substrate-scope translation documented per heme-LL-009.

pathway_4_brain_immune_trafficking.v1_status: directional_panel_pending_construction (component CpGs published, panel not yet built)

pathway_5_direction_as_discriminator.ccl_023_status_post_val_088: REVISED — VAL-088 measured POSITIVE direction (d ≈ +0.91), inverting the cell-fraction-prior NEGATIVE prediction. Cell-fraction direction (Bracci 2022 lymphocytes-down/neutrophils-up) does NOT directly translate to A-score direction (Shannon entropy of methylation). Glioma joins the activation-shifted set (AD, breast, lung, prostate, HCC), not the suppression-shifted set (CRC).
pathway_5_direction_as_discriminator.revised_pattern: Pre-diagnostic CRC at 5-10yr window reads NEGATIVE; everything else (AD, breast, lung, prostate, HCC, glioma) at-diagnosis or post-diagnosis reads POSITIVE. Direction-as-discriminator may collapse to 'early-pre-dx CRC is the outlier'. Pre-diagnostic glioma blood untested (no cohort).

key_results_val_088.design: Stage 1 immune Xu-538 A-score on glioma EPIC whole blood (GSE180683 n=76) vs Italian healthy buffy coat HM450 reference (n=115)
key_results_val_088.data_integrity: PASSED (CHK-3.1 bimodal β; CHK-3.3 panel coverage 90.6%; CHK-3.5 max A 0.519, no saturation)
key_results_val_088.biology_consistency: REFINED — published immunomethylomics/NLR literature consistent with positive direction; CCL-023 cell-fraction-prior bridge inverted
key_results_val_088.interesting_pattern_lgg_d_higher_than_gb: Pre-surgery LGG (n=12) shows d=+1.25 vs healthy; pre-surgery GBM (n=25) shows d=+0.80. Counterintuitive that lower-grade tumor produces larger immune A-score signal; could be sample size effect, or could be biological — LGGs have intact BBB and longer disease duration, possibly producing more sustained peripheral immune trafficking.

key_results_val_089.design: Direct tissue architecture A-score on GSE60274 (Lai 2015) brain tissue 450K platform — 60 primary GBM + 4 paired primary + 4 recurrent + 4 cultured spheres + 5 on-study NTB controls
key_results_val_089.data_integrity: PASSED (CHK-3.1 brain-tissue distribution as expected; CHK-3.3 100% Xu-538 coverage on 450K; CHK-3.5 max A_terminal 1.074, headroom)
key_results_val_089.biology_consistency: PASS with substrate-scope translation. Direction matches Issue 002 prediction; magnitude smaller because v1 is single-substrate methyl-only vs Issue 002 5-substrate cfDNA. Recurrent>primary consistent with disease progression. Spheres NEGATIVE confirms entropy=cell-mixture-diversity, NOT tumorness.
biology_cross_check_findings: GBM primary tissue direction matches Issue 002 framework prediction (positive ΔA), magnitude smaller per CHK-1.5 substrate-scope translation
Recurrent GBM > primary GBM (d +1.17 vs +0.24): disease progression amplifies architecture disruption

Cultured spheres < NTB (d -1.81 NEGATIVE): pure tumor-cell-line β distributions are LESS mixed than mixed-cell tissue. Validates that Shannon entropy of methylation captures cell-mixture diversity, NOT tumor-cell intrinsic property. High A-score is a heterogeneity marker, not a tumor marker.
GBM tumor variance 5x NTB (SD 0.061 vs 0.011): per heme-LL-008, programmed plasticity not noise

honesty_disclosures: Test cohort lacks internal healthy controls

Cannot distinguish glioma from AD on Stage 1 direction alone
Treatment-stage heterogeneity in test cohort; pre-surgery subset (n=37) is cleanest signal

version_history.change: Integrated Loyfer/Moss array atlas as Stage 2 reference for terminal-class detection. Ran VAL-090 with cortical-neuron deconvolution. Blood arm tier promoted from exploratory_pending_replication to single_cohort_validated.

tier_rationale: Three independent positive signals on a single cohort: VAL-088 Stage 1 immune A-score d=+0.91, VAL-090 Stage 2 cortical-neuron cfDNA fraction d=+1.96, VAL-090 Stage 3 NLR cell-fraction shift consistent with Bracci 2022. Tier upgrade qualified by single-cohort blood validation; UCSF AGS phs001497 replication remains highest-priority next step.

stage_2.supplementary_reference: Moss 2018 (Supplementary Table S4) — for cells the Loyfer-array atlas does not separate as sorted-cell entries (lymph node, spleen, esophagus, small intestine, stomach, skin keratinocyte, ovary, adrenal cortex, breast myoepithelial, skeletal muscle)
stage_2.method: NNLS deconvolution via scipy.optimize.nnls; renormalize fractions to sum to 1; no parameter tuning
stage_2.target_cell_for_glioma: Cortical_neurons (sorted-cell reference, indexed to Illumina 450K/EPIC array CpGs)

validations.method: NNLS deconvolution against Loyfer/Moss array atlas (nloyfer/meth_atlas)

CCL_023_status.v0.1_label: O5_POSITIVE_INVERTED (Bracci 2022 cell-fraction prior predicted negative; Stage 1 A-score read positive)
CCL_023_status.v0.2_explanation: VAL-090 Loyfer-atlas deconvolution confirmed the Bracci 2022 cell-fraction prior was correct (neutrophils +16%, lymphocytes -13%). The Shannon-entropy A-score is a different lens on the same disease state, not an opposite signal. Cell-fraction direction and A-score direction are orthogonal (different facets of the same biology) rather than inverted (opposites). See LESSONS_LEARNED.md glioma-LL-001 (revised) and glioma-LL-005 (new — defer-without-reason failure mode).
